body:
## Pull request overview

This PR comprehensively audits and fixes spec UI protocol compliance for view-related components across the ObjectUI codebase. The changes synchronize ViewType enums, Zod validators, TypeScript interfaces, and component registrations to align with the `@objectstack/spec` ListView type definitions and ensure internal consistency.

**Changes:**
- Extended ViewType enum with missing `'gallery'` and `'gantt'` view types to match spec ListView type enum
- Synchronized DetailViewFieldSchema Zod validator with TS interface by adding 11 data-oriented field types and 4 missing properties
- Enhanced DetailViewSectionSchema with `showBorder` and `headerColor` properties in both Zod and component registrations
- Updated ViewSwitcher default labels and icons for gallery (Images) and gantt (GanttChartSquare) views
- Fixed component registration enum values in plugin-list to remove invalid types (`'list'`, `'chart'`) and add spec-compliant types
- Added 8 missing inputs to detail-view component registration (`layout`, `columns`, `loading`, `backUrl`, `editUrl`, `deleteConfirmation`, `header`, `footer`)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/views.ts | Added 'gallery' and 'gantt' to ViewType enum to complete spec ListView type coverage |
| packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts | Added missing field types and properties to DetailViewFieldSchema and DetailViewSectionSchema Zod validators |
| packages/plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx | Added gallery and gantt view labels/icons with proper Lucide icon imports (Images, GanttChartSquare) |
| packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx | Fixed viewType enum in list-view and list registrations to match spec (removed 'list'/'chart', added 'gallery'/'timeline'/'gantt'/'map') |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx | Added 8 missing inputs to detail-view registration and 2 to detail-section registration to match schema definitions |
| ROADMAP.md | Documented all compliance fixes with checkboxes marking completed items |
</details>

The enum format for the 'layout' input is inconsistent with other enum inputs in the codebase. It uses a plain string array ['vertical', 'horizontal', 'grid'] instead of an object array with label/value pairs like other enum inputs (e.g., the 'viewType' enum in plugin-list uses [{ label: 'Grid', value: 'grid' }, ...]). For consistency and better UX in component editors, this should use the object array format: enum: [{ label: 'Vertical', value: 'vertical' }, { label: 'Horizontal', value: 'horizontal' }, { label: 'Grid', value: 'grid' }].
```suggestion
    {
      name: 'layout',
      type: 'enum',
      label: 'Layout Mode',
      enum: [
        { label: 'Vertical', value: 'vertical' },
        { label: 'Horizontal', value: 'horizontal' },
        { label: 'Grid', value: 'grid' },
      ],
    },
```
